reason: Our architect and in-house drafter already do renders and it's baked into the architecture fee, so I'd be paying twice for something we already get. With 20-100 plans in the library, $1,500 a home adds up fast.
objection: What happens every time the client changes the plan? At $500 a round the revisions would eat me alive, and my architect already handles the changes for free.
would_change_my_mind: Unlimited or very cheap revisions, and a flat per-plan library price (build the plan once, reuse it across every lot and elevation) that comes in well under what my architect charges me.
